name: opacity-z-index
note: opacity<1 establishes a stacking context the way a positioned z-index box does: a negative-z-index descendant must stay composited inside the opacity surface instead of escaping to paint below a lower z-index sibling. s2 (opacity 0.6, z-index 5) holds an orange z:-5 child; if the child escaped it would render beneath the black s1, but with the opacity stacking context the whole s2 subtree paints atomically at z5 and blends over s1 at 0.6.
